title: Add State Department travel advisory agent
body: ### Summary - Add a standard-library Python travel advisory agent that fetches the official travel.state.gov RSS feed and maps destinations to State Department risk levels. - Add CLI support for destination arguments and interactive prompts. - Add a random greeting to advisory output. - Improve matching for combined State Department advisories, such as China appearing under “Mainland China, Hong Kong & Macau - See Summaries.” - Add Blocks Network deployment files: `agent-card.json`, Python handler, trigger script, and package metadata. - Add clearer feed fetch errors so local setup problems report the underlying reason. - Add unit tests for parsing, normalization, deduplication, formatting, greeting output, combined advisory matching, not-found behavior, and fetch error detail. ### Testing - `blocks check` - `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` - Direct Python handler invocation with `{\"country\":\"China\"}` returned a Level 2 State Department advisory. ### Deployment note - Blocks Network OAuth login timed out in the cloud environment before registration could complete, so the agent is deployable and locally validated but not registered/running from this VM.
